title: Sync: your new sync code
caption: Turning sync on shows your code once; you type its last group back to confirm you saved it. Phone.

title: Sync: joining from a second device
caption: If this device already has progress, you choose: keep both, or use the cloud copy (the current save is backed up first).

title: Sync: the status line
caption: Once on, one line in the footer says when it last synced. Advanced adds Sync now and Sync options.

title: Sync: options (Advanced)
caption: Show sync code, new sync code, delete cloud copy and turn off sync, each asking before anything is lost.
